summary: Verified the CoinQuest Money Garden harvest-when-overdue-water bug fix end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/garden/farm returns the QA fully-grown but water-overdue plot with status 'ready' and growth_progress 100, and persists 'ready' to Mongo. POST /api/garden/harvest/{plot_id} succeeds, resets the plot to empty, and creates an inventory row. Frontend: /garden route renders 'Ready to Harvest!' with data-testid='harvest-btn' visible; clicking it shows the harvest toast, resets the plot to 'Empty Plot', and the harvested Sunflower appears in the Shop with sell-item-plant_0eb737e556d3. Market is currently CLOSED (17:45 IST > 17:00), so per instructions the Sell button was verified present-and-disabled with the '🌙 Closed (7AM-5PM)' indicator (Sell click / confirm-sell-btn not exercised as spec allowed). Label change to 'Almost Ready!' confirmed in source (75-100 stage). All QA data cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: Market open check uses IST (7-17 Asia/Kolkata), but the review request assumed UTC. Not a bug (comment/docstring in is_market_open() already says IST), but consider surfacing the timezone label to children in the UI ('7AM-5PM IST') to avoid confusion.

MoneyGardenPage renders only farm.plots[0] (single-plot UX) while backend supports up to 50 plots and buy-plot endpoint. Multi-plot UI seems missing; only relevant if product intends multiple plots for grade 1-2.

get_farm ordering is insertion-order (no sort); if the initial 4 plots exist first and a new plot is bought, it becomes plots[4]. Not a concern for the current single-plot UX but worth being explicit.
seed_data_creation: Inserted farm_plots doc plot_id='QA_garden_plot' (Sunflower, planted 3 days ago, status water_needed, growth 100). Cleaned up: 1 plot + 1 harvest_inventory row deleted post-test. Verified 0 remaining docs for the test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. get_farm computes growth from elapsed time first and marks growth>=100 as 'ready' even if water is overdue. UI harvest-btn / sell-item-<plant_id> / confirm-sell-btn testids are in place. Sell flow completion was not exercised because market IST hours were closed at time of test (~17:45 IST); a re-test between 7-17 IST could exercise confirm-sell-btn and validate coins increase. All QA data cleaned up.
rca of the issue: Original: get_farm applied watering-overdue penalties (water_needed/wilting/dead) BEFORE checking growth, so a plant that had reached growth_progress>=100 while overdue for water was stuck in water_needed and never moved to 'ready'; the frontend's harvest button only renders when plot.status==='ready', so the child had no way to harvest. Fix (verified in /app/backend/routes/garden.py:74-108): compute growth_progress from (now - planted_at) FIRST; if >=100 set status='ready' and persist; only apply watering penalties while growth<100. Frontend also renamed 75-99% label from 'Ready!' to 'Almost Ready!' to reduce confusion.
